decision or result: Landed. vsesvit_core::permissions::queue owns the permission prompt queue: Queue<R> over a shell-chosen request handle (a request is a handle plus the permissions it asks for), with the tab's one-time grants. Landed. engine_bridge::start(cx, parts, desktop, routes) returns Started { engine, pump }. The engine it hands out is a forwarding GuardedEngine: it publishes PageFocus::NEW_BROWSER before create_tab (unless the tab's browser already exists) and the tab's policy before load, load_html, reload, go_back and go_forward; its focus_page and blur_page go through the policy, and set_page_focus from anywhere else is logged and ignored. focus.rs keeps the three facts per window (active, selected tab, keyboard owner), publishes every changed policy and then makes at most one native focus move, with no borrow held across engine or surface calls; a press in the active window's page area (screen rect minus its interactive holes, toplevel_at must name the window) hands the page the keyboard; FocusChanged { focused: true } that the policy did not allow first drains pending presses, then accepts a press into the page under 500 ms old taken while the keyboard has not moved since, else blurs the page and gives the keyboard back; a page focus the OS refused is retried at the next set_page_area. The router delivers each event in its own update: focus sees Created, FocusChanged, TakeFocus, Closed and Detached first; prompts go to their owner's stub (context_menu, tab::prompts, privacy::permissions) and PromptEnded to the same owner; downloads and page messages to their stubs; requests complete tasks; the rest goes to the ShellRoutes trait the Shell installs. The pump steps at once, on wakes, at most 33 ms apart while active and 250 ms after 1 s quiet; PumpHandle::stop returns the driver. Key routing is built from core: Reserved chords BeforePage, Overridable and Native AfterPage, plus Chrome's six tab keys. GPUI bindings carry a meta tag so install and suspend replace only ours; keystrokes follow what the backends report (Shift with a digit or symbol arrives as the shifted character; the X11 keypad's plus and minus as add and subtract).
